name: Le bamboo shoots
summary: Go Vietnam’s Kon Tum cluster article names le bamboo shoots, Bambusa nutans, grilled fresh or boiled from dried shoots. The flavour it prints is sweet and crisp. One plate price is on that article.
origin: Go Vietnam lists Central Highlands le bamboo shoots among the specialties of the Kon Tum cluster.
taste: Go Vietnam prints a sweet, crisp flavour for shoots that are grilled fresh or boiled after drying.
howToEat: Eat the fresh shoots grilled, or the dried shoots boiled. A recipe beyond that line was not printed. The cluster article prints 30,000–60,000 VND a plate.
where: The Kon Tum cluster, on that article. A stall and a clock were not printed. Check on arrival.
priceBand: Go Vietnam’s cluster article prints 30,000–60,000 VND a plate.
seoTitle: Le bamboo shoots in Kon Tum
